title: Why “Regional” Undersells What GOFO Can Carry
summary: GOFO is now an EasyPost Wallet Carrier. Ground coverage across 75% of the U.S. population, lithium-ion accepted, no contract and no integration to build.
body_markdown:
GOFO is now available through the[EasyPost Wallet Carrier](https://www.easypost.com/wallet/) . Create a GOFO account from your dashboard, ship on rates we already negotiated, and pay for the labels from the same Wallet you’re using for everything else.


> “With billions of shipments, 100,000+ shippers relying on us, and 100+ carriers in our network, I thought we’d seen everything. But GOFO sets a new standard. Its network spans more than 300 hubs and stations covering over 12,000 ZIP codes. Its fast ground transit times and competitive rates make it a serious alternative to legacy carriers.”
>
>
> — Jarrett Streebin, CEO, EasyPost


##


GOFO takes the shipments other regionals can’t accept


There’s a reason so many shippers have been requesting GOFO through EasyPost. UPS and FedEx raised rates 5.9% on average in 2026, surcharges keep widening, and every carrier you add to spread that exposure has historically brought its own contract, integration, and invoice with it.


GOFO is one of EasyPost’s largest regional carriers joining the


[EasyPost Wallet Carrier](https://www.easypost.com/wallet/) program, allowing GOFO to be one of the most accessible regional carriers available to shippers across the U.S.


- **Nationwide reach across 75% of the U.S** . Covers 12,000+ ZIP codes, including Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


- **Fast, predictable ground transit.** Delivers eligible parcels in 1–5 business days.


- **GOFO ATLAS intelligent operations.** Connects sorting, routing, visibility, pickup, and labor planning through one parcel-level data system.


- **Reliable service quality at scale.** 99.8% delivery success and 98.5% on-time delivery.


GOFO’s ZIP coverage is nearly unprecedented for a traditional “regional” carrier, and nearly rivals that of the national providers. Combine the vast coverage area with the lithium-ion support and GOFO becomes a regional carrier that can do more than take on a small percentage of your shipments, allowing you to significantly save on shipping costs year round.


##


GOFO + EasyPost Wallet Carriers


As an EasyPost Wallet Carrier, shipping GOFO through EasyPost will come with these additional benefits:


- Create a shipper account directly from the dashboard with ease


- Access prenegotiated rates without contracts, fees, or negotiations


- Centralize label payments through your EasyPost Wallet


There’s no contract to sign, which means you can test GOFO on real lanes instead of modeling it in a spreadsheet. Run your densest origins against what you’re paying today, watch how those lanes actually perform, and expand only where the rates and the delivery data hold up. If they don’t, there’s nothing to unwind.


[Log in to your EasyPost dashboard](https://app.easypost.com/login) and add GOFO, or ask your customer success manager to get you set up.
